verdict.rationale: Trivy can scan many targets in a single invocation. `trivy k8s --report summary cluster` scans a whole Kubernetes cluster, and filesystem scans pick up all lock files in a project. A community user also notes it is easy to write automation around. However, nothing documents explicit bulk operations, such as batch-scanning lists of images or acting on many findings at once. missing for 10: documented batch/multi-target scanning of arbitrary item lists, bulk actions on results, an agent-facing (MCP) bulk workflow, independent hands-on corroboration of bulk usage.
